description:
A little forest ambience in Yport on a wind-free sunny but cold day in January. We can here quite a few different birds, if you recognise some  drop me a message please.


Gear: Zoom F3 + Clippy EM272Z1 with around 40cm distance.
Format: Stereo, 32bit/96kHz made available in 24bit here. 

Post-Prod: RX Denoising & Normalisation
